req.title: Player update persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall write updates to the players table so subsequent GET calls reflect the modification.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/{squadNumber} must persist updates so subsequent GET calls reflect the change. The source reveals: (1) the PUT endpoint is PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}, returns HTTP 204 on success; (2) update_by_squad_number_async has a deliberate bug — it always returns False after commit (no exception path returns True), so the route raises HTTP 500; (3) a squad_number mismatch between body and path returns 400; (4) a missing player returns 404. Tests must cover: positive persistence (PUT then GET), negative paths (404, 400, squad_number mismatch), and boundary cases (squad_number at edges of the seeded dataset). Mutation-resilient assertions use exact status codes, exact field values, and verify both the PUT response and the subsequent GET response to confirm DB persistence.

tests.name: test_put_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update
preconditions: DB contains player with squadNumber=10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with updated first_name='UpdatedKabir', last_name='UpdatedReddy', position='Left Winger', squad_number=10
expected: GET returns HTTP 200 with updated first_name='UpdatedKabir' and last_name='UpdatedReddy'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "UpdatedKabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "UpdatedReddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Left Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "UpdatedKabir"
    assert body["lastName"] == "UpdatedReddy"
    assert body["position"] == "Left Winger"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 10
